slots.title: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Numbers the spy agency handed over in the 1990s, long suspected of hiding a backdoor, turn out to have come from a basic computer program. Bitcoin was never on that list, and its quantum problem hasn’t gone anywhere.

slots.title: Bitget to discontinue services for some users in one-off exercise
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: Bitget says user funds are safe and exchange will continue to operate during the change.

slots.title: Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google’s new Willow breakthrough
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Google says its Willow chip can prepare the special quantum states needed for advanced calculations with about 40 times fewer errors, reducing one of the hardware bottlenecks behind any future attempt to crack bitcoin wallets.

slots.title: Mark Wahlberg wants to take on the longevity-startup crowd with an affordable gym concept
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Mark Wahlberg, who once sank money into a gym chain that got kicked off the NYSE, is now building his own, and he promises you’ll get a cold plunge, a blood panel and a protein muffin without needing a trust fund.

slots.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street closes at 4. Tokenized stocks keep trading
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: Tokenized stocks are drawing trading activity beyond Wall Street hours, while Bitcoin miners confront costly AI expansion and new accounting rules could benefit stablecoins.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost. Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August, but there was never any indication that it was no longer with Anthropic.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
